description: Edit a Kamchatka trip plan from make_trip_plan by its ID: add, remove, move or replace a day, change lodging or group, shift the whole trip, apply a flight delay; untouched days stay. Tours whose date or group changed get seats and price re-read; a date shift also re-reads park closures and MChS reports. An impossible edit (arrival day, activity not for the children's age, out of season, no solution) is refused with the reason and the plan stays. Plans live 7 days; no plan — call make_trip_plan first.

action.description: add_day (a day with an activity), remove_day, move_day, replace_day (another activity that day), set_lodging, set_party (group), shift_dates (the whole trip) or flight_delay (only when the person says the flight is delayed).

adults.description: For set_party: number of adults, 1–30; omitted keeps the current number.

children.description: For set_party: age of each child in years — NOT a count ("6, 10" or [6, 10]; a baby under one — "0 years" or [0]); "no" removes the children; omitted keeps the current children. An activity too young for the youngest child is a refusal naming the days.

day.description: Day number in the plan, for remove_day, move_day and replace_day.

delay_days.description: For flight_delay: how many days the arrival flight is delayed, 1–7.

interest.description: Activity for add_day and replace_day, free text (Russian works best).

keep_return.description: For flight_delay: yes keeps the return date and shortens the trip (default); no shifts the whole trip.

lodging.description: Lodging level for set_lodging: economy (camps, hostels, tents), comfort (hotels, apartments) or premium (lodges).

plan_id.description: Plan ID from the make_trip_plan answer.

shift_days.description: For shift_dates without start_date: how many days to move the trip, signed — 7 is a week later, -3 is three days earlier.

start_date.description: For shift_dates: the new first day of the trip, by the Kamchatka calendar — YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, or a day or month in Russian words; the trip keeps its length.

to_day.description: New position of the day, for move_day.

name: edit_trip_plan
title: Edit trip plan
